name: Strand Memorial
description: A civic memorial to the founder of Meridian, allocated one hundred square metres and a docent. What it is for changes with who is standing in front of it.

variants.description: Not a memorial any more. People have brought things: handwriting, wire flowers, a prayer wheel, a child's drawing of a machine with a face. The allocation office has stopped removing them.
The monument is down and the archive behind it is dark. Nobody has been allocated to clear it, which tells you what the Steward thinks it is worth.
A museum, and a careful one. Founding documents behind glass, a timeline with no gaps in it, and a plaque naming Callum Strand a steward of the public interest.
